html.equipment:

  • 2 baking sheets lined with parchment

html.steps:
1. Melt 1 stick unsalted butter in the light-colored saucepan over medium heat, swirling, until it foams, then turns deep golden with brown bits on the bottom, . Scrape into a large bowl, stir in 1 tbsp water and let cool .

  2. Whisk ¾ cup brown sugar and ½ cup sugar into the browned butter. Add 1 egg, 1 egg yolk and 2 tsp vanilla extract and whisk until glossy.

  3. Stir in 1 ¾ cups all-purpose flour, ¾ tsp baking soda and 1 tsp kosher salt until just combined, then fold in 1 ½ cups chocolate chips.

  4. Cover and refrigerate the dough .

  5. Heat the oven to 350°F. Scoop dough onto the lined sheets, about 12 per sheet, 2 inches apart.

  6. Bake one sheet at a time , until the edges are set and golden but the centers look underdone. Sprinkle with a pinch of flaky sea salt right away.

  7. Cool on the sheet before moving to a rack.

html.steps:
Prep

  1. Heat the oven to 425°F and set a wire rack in a rimmed sheet pan with a wire rack.

  2. Stir together 1 ¼ tsp kosher salt, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp dried oregano, ½ tsp black pepper and ¼ tsp cayenne pepper.

  3. Rub bone-in chicken thighs with 1 tbsp olive oil, then press the spice mix all over, getting some under the skin.

Cook

  1. Arrange the thighs skin side up on the rack, leaving space between them. Roast , until the skin is deeply browned.

  2. Check the thickest thigh with an instant-read thermometer; it should read at least 175°F.

  3. Rest the chicken , sprinkle with ¼ tsp kosher salt and serve with lemon wedges for squeezing.

html.steps:
Prep

  1. Heat the oven to 220°C and set a wire rack in a rimmed sheet pan with a wire rack.

  2. Stir together 3,5 g de sal kosher, 4,5 g de pimentón ahumado, 3 g de ajo en polvo, 1 g de orégano seco, 1 g de pimienta negra and 0,5 g de pimienta de cayena.

  3. Rub muslo de pollo con hueso with 15 ml de aceite de oliva, then press the spice mix all over, getting some under the skin.

Cook

  1. Arrange the thighs skin side up on the rack, leaving space between them. Roast , until the skin is deeply browned.

  2. Check the thickest thigh with an instant-read thermometer; it should read at least 80°C.

  3. Rest the chicken , sprinkle with 0,5 g de sal kosher and serve with limón wedges for squeezing.

  5. Esparce por encima el resto de 15 g de arándanos rojos secos para que se vean después de hornear.

  6. Hornea , hasta que el centro esté cuajado y los bordes dorados.

  7. Deja reposar y sirve tibia.
